skills.description_zh: Provides comprehensive guidance for executing image-to-video (图生视频) generation via the dreamina CLI for 即梦. This skill covers 4 sub-commands selected by input type: image2video (1 image → animate), frames2video (2 images → transition via --first/--last), multiframe2video (2-20 storyboard images → narrative via --images and --transition-prompt), and multimodal2video (up to 9 images + 3 videos + 3 audio → synthesis). Use when the user has reference images or media files and wants to generate video via CLI; mentions \"dreamina image2video\", \"图生视频CLI\", \"frames2video\", \"multiframe2video\", \"multimodal2video\"; or provides media files and asks to animate or synthesize them. This skill covers mode detection with a decision tree, parameter name differences between sub-commands, input limits per mode, and 4 mode-specific execution workflows. Always use this skill when the user wants to generate video from reference media via the dreamina command line.
skills.name: 即梦-图生视频 CLI 技能，让你的智能体通过 即梦 CLI 生成视频
